user.title: Assist LLM (Deutsch)
user.description: Registers a German LLM API ("Assist (Deutsch)") that keeps all official Assist tools while replacing the English core prompt texts with German versions.

init.title: Assist LLM (Deutsch) options
init.description: Controls automatic conversation history reset for conversations using Assist (Deutsch).

data_description.reset_history: Clears the finished conversation immediately after the response so the next request automatically starts with a new conversation ID and empty history.
data_description.keep_history_on_followup: If the assistant asks a follow-up question (e.g. ends with a question mark), keeps the history for the user's reply and resets it afterwards.

clear_conversations.name: Clear conversation history
clear_conversations.description: Immediately clears all idle Home Assistant conversation sessions so new requests start with a fresh conversation ID.
